newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba - no news conference after today's meeting.
newsitem.headline: Buba - no news conference after today's meeting.

text.p: The Bundesbank said it would not hold a press conference after its regular council meeting on Thursday.
The German central bank said on Wednesday that it would hold a press conference on its 1996 balance sheet on April 17.

All 10 economists surveyed by Reuters about their expectations for today's meeting said the Bundesbank was likely to leave all interest rates unchanged. The discount rate is at 2.5 percent with the Lombard rate at 4.5 percent and the main money market rate at three percent.
